title: X402 Domain Scanner
description: Scan a root domain for X402 payment endpoints. Enter a domain and optionally list specific paths to check (one per line).

domain.title: Root Domain
domain.description: Enter the domain to scan (without https://). Example: stech-api.sheradogilang.workers.dev

paths.title: Specific Paths to Check (Optional)
paths.description: List specific paths to check, one per line. Must start with a slash (/). Leave empty to auto-discover all endpoints.

maxPaths.title: Max Paths (Dictionary Fallback)
maxPaths.description: Maximum number of paths to try when using the built-in dictionary.

useResidentialProxy.title: Use Residential Proxy (Bypass Blocks)
useResidentialProxy.description: Route requests through residential IPs to avoid datacenter blocks. Additional cost applies.

limit.title: Probe Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of endpoints to actively probe (useful for teaser/credit systems).
